sandbachFocus: Leaders Sandbach United host Alsager Town at home on Saturday 3 October, looking to bounce back from their most recent loss. Sandbach remain top of the table with 22 points from 10 games despite that defeat, and face an Alsager side in poor form at the foot of the league with just 4 points from 10 matches.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town in a key fixture for the title race, with Stafford chasing the leaders on 20 points. AFC Bridgnorth host Eccleshall in a promising clash between two in-form sides — Bridgnorth have won three of their last four, while Eccleshall have won their last two despite recent struggles. Wolverhampton Casuals welcome Wednesfield Community in a contest between mid-table sides, with Casuals having won their last two games. Foley Meir host Bilston Town, with Bilston in strong recent form (three wins in their last four). Market Drayton Town face struggling New Mills at home, with both sides looking for consistency. Shawbury United host Barnton; Shawbury are in dire form with six consecutive losses. Crewe host Allscott Heath in a contest between lower-table sides. Cheadle Heath Nomads visit Telford Town, another fixture featuring sides near the bottom of the table. Brereton Social host Widnes Town, with the visitors bottom of the league having taken just 2 points all season. On Wednesday 7 October, Brereton Social then host Wednesfield Community in a midweek encounter.
